page.overview:
Who is Abe the Monkey Man?

Abe the Monkey Man is a monkey-like person who has a pet monkey with him on his shoulder — part of Yu-Gi-Oh!.

He Dueled in the Kaiba Corp Grand Championship, containing many of the best Duelists around the world. He beats Totani Ialos in Round 1 but loses to Rebecca Hawkins in Round 2. According to Abe, his pet monkey is "the smart one", as it seems to make most of the decisions in Duels, selecting which cards to use.

No cards in this Duelist's Deck were shown. scope="col" | Opponent(s) ! scope="col" | Episode(s) !
